pages.title: Possessing
pages.text: The yellow chalk, also known as golden chalk, brings a sparkle to the eyes of those who$(br) engage in possessions, serving as the main glyph in this type of ritual.$(br)

Possessions are a variation of summoning, caused by a transformation in geometry and$(br) the addition of yellow glyphs, allowing spirits to manifest in bodies (material prisons)$(br)  different from their usual ones.$(br)
